create.name: Edmonton Insight Meditation
create.bio:
Edmonton Insight Meditation is a volunteer-run Buddhist sangha in Edmonton, Alberta, practising vipassana and loving-kindness meditation in the Insight tradition that grew out of the early Buddhist teachings. It grew from a two-year Deepening Practice programme that the Salt Spring Island teacher Heather Martin ran for Alberta students from 2017, organised in Edmonton by her long-time student Olenka Melnyk; when the programme ended, the local group wanted somewhere to keep practising together, and the sangha took shape from there. It has no single guiding teacher, relying instead on a circle of visiting senior teachers and its own experienced members.

The main gathering is a three-hour mini-retreat on the third Saturday morning of each month, with sitting, a talk or study, and discussion, held in a community-league hall and, in some months, on Zoom; members also meet to sit together on the first Saturday. Through the year the sangha hosts online courses, daylong and residential retreats, often jointly with the Saskatoon insight community, and keeps a public archive of recorded Dharma talks. Teachings are offered by donation, and the group welcomes people of any background.

courses.title: Metta Retreat - June 5-11, 2027
courses.description: A seven-day residential loving-kindness retreat at Star of the North Retreat Centre in St. Albert, co-hosted with the Saskatoon insight community and taught by Adrianne Ross, Rachel Lewis and Jeanne Corrigal. It can be combined with the insight retreat that follows.

courses.title: Insight Meditation Retreat - June 11-20, 2027
courses.description: A ten-day residential vipassana retreat at Star of the North Retreat Centre in St. Albert, taught by Jeanne Corrigal together with Guy Armstrong and Sally Clough-Armstrong and co-hosted with the Saskatoon insight community.

free_resources.title: Saturday Morning Sits
free_resources.description: A monthly three-hour morning of meditation, Dharma study and discussion on the third Saturday, led by a visiting teacher or by the sangha, in person and in some months on Zoom. No registration; suitable for beginners and experienced meditators.

free_resources.title: Videos
free_resources.description: An archive of recorded Saturday Dharma talks and retreat talks from the sangha's visiting teachers, with notes and further reading for each theme.
